description: Request duration in milliseconds, as a distribution, from the access line's durationMs field (#805). Labelled by route only: a distribution is the expensive metric kind, so method and status are deliberately left off to keep the series count down -- use skopeo_requests for those breakdowns.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="CLOUD_RUN_SERVICE_PLACEHOLDER" AND jsonPayload.logger="org.skopeo.access" AND jsonPayload.durationMs>=0
